systems.system: National number (General Administration of Civil Registry)

SDN.note: Only banks checking the number against the civil registry system; no exchange between civil register and ID.
No count or share of people holding the number.
Nothing on a number at birth.
Nothing on who operates or maintains the system.
Banks are private checkers of the number, not a public register keyed on it.
The circular does not state that the system issues unique numbers or credentials.
